message.text: Here it is: a new card at the top of your inbox, made from the VS Code tab.
Live now: the rail is one timeline, newest first. Groups and cards are mixed, each with its last-updated time top-right, and this card sits at the top under Live.

The "More: this card's files, its full words, what it cost" fold is a fixed label. It isn't built from what's inside, and cost is never drawn on task cards (ai2/card.js line 422). Sent to the AI 2 lead: the label will list what's actually there, in plain words ("Your dictation � 3 files � $1.42"). Cost moves onto the card face, reading "not tracked" when nothing measured it. An empty fold won't be drawn.

place.ask: Split the "Cards & content" group in two?

options.caveat: Each group is smaller and clearer, but there's one more row in the rail.
Fewer rows, but card work and content modules stay mixed.

place.ask: What should the fold at the bottom of a card say?
place.hint: Type your own words. Answering again replaces the old answer.

place.text: Are you able to put arbitrary content onto this card?
place.raw: Also, are you able to put arbitrary content onto this card? This new card dash five that you just made?

message.text: Live now: the fold says what is in it ("Show who worked on it, the files in this card's folder"; the full text and links are named with counts when present), and the card head always says what it cost, or "cost not tracked".
